items.name: meeting-notes
items.title: Meeting Notes
items.description: Turn a meeting transcript, recording summary, or rough notes into a record people act on: decisions with their reasons, action items with one owner and a date each, open questions, and a short summary, in the team's existing notes format, with nothing invented and unclear attributions marked. Use after a meeting, when a transcript needs to become a shareable record, or when action items from a meeting keep getting lost.
items.author: Khaled Saeed
